Summing explicitly yields g_n(d)-d^2(l-r)^2/[4(d+1)] for exterior lengths l=i-1,r=n-j. Fixed span is best balanced; the proof excludes odd exterior sums by forward difference for d<=(2n+3)/3 or average even neighbor comparison for larger d, with small n checked separately. The exact cubic P(n,k) sign is positive iff n>=8k+10 on admissible steps, proving unique maximizer k=floor((n-2)/8), endpoints k+1,n-k. Asymptotic d=3n/4 gives Kmin=7n^3/96+O(n^2) and relative reduction 9/16. Independently computed exact Fraction potential-variance gains and exhaustive shortcut winners for 3<=n<=44 matched uniqueness. That finite range is not an all-n proof; the sign-polynomial analysis is decisive.
